name: banking_list_recent_transactions
description: List recent transactions for an account within optional date range.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: End date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return. Defaults to "20".

output_schema.description: A JSON string with the list of transactions, or a JSON error message.
